answer.explanation: Within 19:56:12-20:06:12Z the Uploader logged 388 '[ERROR] NoSuchBucket ... PutObject' failures from handler.py line 29 (S3.put_object(Bucket=OUTPUT_BUCKET)). The Uploader ran cleanly until 19:30:58Z. That is when a burst of fresh INIT_START events appeared, which usually means the configuration changed and new execursion environments were started; the failures began on those new environments and have continued since. NoSuchBucket means the bucket named in OUTPUT_BUCKET does not exist, which points to a bad live environment variable value rather than an IAM denial (which would be AccessDenied). The other three functions show no errors. Limitations: I could not read the live function configuration, the IaC template or CloudTrail history with the available tools, so I could not confirm the bad bucket name or whether the change came from the template (IAC) rather than a manual edit.
